philosophy: Quality, usefulness and defensible rights drive acquisition; the target never overrides an acceptance gate.
counting_rules: Count independent substantial works or complete practical resources once; book chapters stored separately share a work_id.
Do not count links, photographs, companion metadata, duplicate formats, LFS pointers, archive containers or artificially split files.
A historical teaching supplement is not a current Kenyan authority or a complete CPA course.
quality_gates: Exact syllabus/sitting scope known; topic contribution and limitations recorded.
Credible author and editorial evidence; selected examples independently checked where applicable; current technical claims verified.
Exact-edition rights established for planned commercial hosting; third-party questions/images/solutions separately resolved or omitted.
Complete bytes parse; no LFS pointers, unexpected archive payloads or active launch/JavaScript actions; hashes and provenance recorded.
Attribution, adaptation notices and licence obligations included; no invented endorsement.
completion_gates: Lock the official syllabus, exam sitting, transition rules and tax/standards cut-off.
Every examinable topic has an accurate teaching source and useful worked practice, with Kenyan authority where relevant.
All distributed files pass rights and integrity gates; link-only/licensing gaps are explicitly unresolved.
Every paper passes independent subject-expert review; workshops/practical official participation is separately required.
Test offline index, catalogue database, cloud synchronization, manifest and downloadable archive.
Reach the planning target through useful independent resources; if quantity conflicts with quality, report the gap rather than pad.
removal_policy: Exclude unsuitable, duplicate, superseded or disputed items from approved distribution; preserve decision/provenance history. A dead source URL does not itself invalidate a usable locally licensed file. No hard deletion of audit history.
review_policy: Hourly work prioritises gaps and new evidence. Stable items receive targeted rechecks, not unnecessary redownloads. On exact-byte, licence, technical-rule or source-terms change, reassess the affected uses before replacing an approved version.
known_blockers: Current full official syllabus/transition objectives not secured as a verified primary PDF.
No licensed KASNEB past-paper PDFs or video recordings acquired.
Current Kenyan company/law/tax, advanced reporting, ISA/IPSAS and examiner-style worked solutions remain incomplete.
hosting_workflow: maintenance/README.md; use scoped temporary exact-content upload proxy and close it after verified transfers
integration_policy: Continue with available Supabase, GitHub, research APIs, Library and scheduling. Do not use or suggest Dropbox again for this request.
